card.text: Explore Portia through its published prolate shape model.

introduction.text: Portia lends its name to a crowded group of moons close to Uranus. Voyager 2 observations reveal an elongated body, while its surface remains unresolved in useful detail.

model.title: Shape approximation
model.summary: Voyager-based shape estimate with two axes assumed equal. The gray grid marks missing surface imagery.
